title: Vacuum Failure of the Third Law of Black-Hole Thermodynamics
exact_target: Construct gravitational-wave collapse that first produces a subextremal apparent horizon and later an exactly extremal Kerr event horizon.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005863 (OWR-14298170-020). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Analysis, Geometry and Topology of Positive Scalar Curvature Metrics (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/9, pp. 483--566. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The source distinguishes apparent and event horizons; the statement does not require that a single local horizon abruptly change its Kerr parameter. Contextual duplicate 30005862 is excluded.
